title: Why Your Product Photo File Names Are Killing Your SEO (Fix It in 5 Minutes)
description: Product photo filenames affect Google rankings more than most sellers realize. Here's the naming convention that boosts SEO.

blocks.text: Your product photos have a hidden SEO signal you're probably ignoring: filenames.
Every time you upload "IMG_2847.jpg" to your store, Google gets zero information about the image. Rename it "womens-black-leather-boots-size-8.jpg" and you've suddenly gained an SEO win.
Here's the full protocol.
Why Filenames Matter
Google's image algorithm reads:
You control three of four. Most sellers ignore filenames entirely.
The Naming Convention
Bad: IMG_2847.jpg, DSC_1234.png, photo (2).jpg
Good: [product-name]-[key-descriptor]-[SKU or variant].jpg
Examples:
Keep filenames under 60 characters, use hyphens (not underscores), all lowercase.
The Workflow
Step 1: Shoot your product photos.
Step 2: Upload to edit-photo.com for background removal and editing.
Step 3: Before downloading, rename files using the convention above.
Step 4: Upload to your store with proper alt text matching the filename.
The Alt Text Companion
Alt text is the other half of image SEO. For every product photo:

items.text: Include the main keyword you want to rank for
Add one specific descriptor (color, size, material)

blocks.text: Example alt text: "White ceramic coffee mug with black handle, 12oz capacity, dishwasher safe"
Google's AI reads this and ranks accordingly.
The Batch Renaming Trick
For a larger catalog, don't rename manually. Use:

items.text: A spreadsheet with SKUs and desired filenames

blocks.text: Process up to 20 images per batch in edit-photo, then use your operating system or catalog workflow to apply descriptive file names.
Common Mistakes
Keyword stuffing: "best-cheap-womens-black-leather-boots-fashion-2024-buy-now.jpg" gets penalized. Keep it natural.
Using special characters: Spaces, %, &, and other characters break URLs. Use hyphens only.
Random numbers: IMG_2847 tells Google nothing. Descriptive words = SEO gold.
Not matching alt text: Filename and alt text should reinforce the same keywords, not conflict.
The Compound Effect
Rename 100 product photos properly. Add proper alt text. Ensure clean, high-quality images via edit-photo.com. Watch Google Image Search send you free traffic within 30-60 days.
This traffic converts well because these visitors were searching visually—they're closer to buying than pure text-search visitors.
The Full Image SEO Trifecta

items.text: Alt text: Natural description with target keyword

blocks.text: Nail all three and you unlock a traffic channel most sellers ignore.
Start Fixing Filenames Today
Small fix, big compounding return. Combine with clean editing at edit-photo.com for maximum SEO impact.
